name: claude-railguards
description: Deterministic pre-write governance for AI coding agents — rules files request, this enforces. Anti-duplication prior-art guard, pre-implementation gate, QA-report-as-a-merge-gate.

plugins.name: railguards
plugins.description: Blocks the agent from re-implementing existing capability (PreToolUse prior-art guard), enforces a pre-implementation investigation gate, and validates a QA-report contract before risky changes. Git-side guards (branch/secrets/large-file/hash-stamp) install via the bundled bin/install-git-hooks.
